intent: One identity entry, phone-first and WhatsApp-native, shown as a full screen straight after the introduction (ADR 0038: no guest mode, so there is no guest-gate sheet, no context line and nothing to resume). A returning account lands on Home; a new account continues to About you (name and sex required, Terms and Privacy accepted) and then to the optional onboarding steps. Password, biometric unlock and password recovery are tertiary paths.

screens.purpose: The single identity entry (no separate Sign up and Login), a full screen after the introduction and the only door into the app: phone number first, then Apple or Google, with the password as the tertiary path. There is no 'continue as guest' and no sheet variant.
interactions: Compound phone field: fixed non-interactive +965 chip plus eight digits, numeric keypad, LTR in both languages, loose shape check; primary gold button 'Send code' (WhatsApp mark) / «إرسال الرمز» sends the code and opens CL-AUTH-02
Secondary buttons: 'Apple' (iOS only) and 'Google' (a new identity continues to About you, CL-AUTH-03); tertiary text link 'Password' / «كلمة المرور» opens CL-AUTH-04
Back returns to the introduction; there is no skip, no guest entry and no context line

A quiet info glyph at the foot opens the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy and the line 'Hotel or service provider? Use the Ghazal Partner app' that explains this screen creates a Client account only (CA-AUTH-12); there is no account-type chooser in the client app
screens.contentNotes: Title «تسجيل الدخول» / 'Sign in' with one drawing (a key). Phone display uses the formatter: +965 5000 0012 inside an LTR isolate, never a tappable tel: link in the prototype. Error copy is calm and blameless: «تحققوا من الرقم: يجب أن يتكون من 8 أرقام» / 'Check the number: it needs 8 digits'; not on WhatsApp: 'We could not send a code to this number on WhatsApp' with Apple, Google and Support offered (there is no SMS fallback, ADR 0028). Apple private-relay email handled silently. Acceptance of the Terms happens at account creation in CL-AUTH-03. Tab bar hidden.

screens.purpose: Verify the phone with a six-digit code delivered over WhatsApp. Also reused inline in the booking Details step and for password reset and phone change.
interactions: Six boxes in LTR order in both languages (digit 1 at the left), paste and one-time-code autofill, Eastern digits normalised on paste
Resend after a 60-second countdown; 'Open WhatsApp' link; 'Change number' returns to the sign-in screen
Five attempts, then a temporary lock state; code lives 5 minutes
Delivery-failed state offers resend, Apple, Google and Support (no SMS fallback)
Success draws the check once (success haptic) and continues: a new account goes to About you (CL-AUTH-03), an existing account lands on Home
screens.contentNotes: Heading is a noun phrase, not an imperative: «رمز التحقق المرسل إلى +965 5000 0012» / 'Code sent to +965 5000 0012' with the number in an LTR isolate. Wrong code, passive and calm: «الرمز غير صحيح، يمكنكم المحاولة مرة أخرى» / 'That code is not right. You can try again'. Expired: 'This code has expired. A new one is on its way when you tap Resend'. Locked: 'Too many attempts. Please try again later or contact Support'. In the booking flow the same component appears as a sheet titled 'Verify your number to send the request' without leaving the step. Store-review demo account is a production flag, never visible in the UI.

screens.purpose: Final step for a brand-new account, and the step that opens the app: the name and the sex are required, then the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy are accepted. Both name and sex stay editable in Profile (CL-PROF-03).
interactions: Full name field (dir=auto, prefilled when Apple or Google gave one); required

Sex: two large tiles, Female / Male («أنثى» «ذكر»), each with an abstract gender symbol from the icon registry (no faces); exactly one must be chosen (OQ-R2-02: stored on the account, not shown to venues, not used to filter)
Optional email field (LTR, email keyboard)
Checkbox 'I agree' with an info glyph that opens the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy in-app; required before Continue
Primary 'Continue' / «متابعة» creates the account and continues to the optional onboarding steps (CL-ONBD-03)
Live monogram preview in the first letter of the name
screens.contentNotes: Title «نبذة عنكم» / 'About you' with the live monogram at its end edge. Name example «ريم الدوسري», email optional 'reem@example.com'. Acceptance is logged once per account. The Arabic checkbox label is a statement of acceptance, not an imperative: «أوافق». Tab bar hidden. Voucher model (ADR 0033): the terms link lists the platform terms and the voucher terms in one reader; the voucher terms say in plain words that the KD 2 is paid to Ghazal, that the event price is paid to the venue directly, and when a voucher is reusable, forfeited or eligible for a credit voucher from support.

ownerRound1.change: Terms line: lapse forfeits, support credit instead of refund
ownerRound1.note: Voucher line in the terms: "The KD 2 is paid to Ghazal. If you do not confirm in 24 hours the voucher is no longer valid. Refunds are credit vouchers from support, never money."

screens.purpose: Tertiary path for people who prefer a password: sign in, create a password account, and recover a forgotten password, as modes of one screen.
interactions: Sign in: identifier (Kuwait mobile with the fixed +965 chip; no email sign-in) and password with show/hide; 'Forgot password?' link
Create account: verified mobile number first through the WhatsApp code, then a new password with live strength and rules; the account is created once the number is verified
Forgot password: request a WhatsApp code to the verified number (email link only where a verified email exists), enter the code, then set a new password
Mode switch link at the bottom: 'New here? Create an account' / «حساب جديد» and back to the WhatsApp sign-in (CL-AUTH-01)
screens.contentNotes: Identifier rule: The Kuwait mobile number behind the fixed non-interactive +965 chip is the only identifier, as in CL-AUTH-01; no other country codes in the MVP (a foreign number signs in with Apple or Google, OQ-L-14); email is optional and never an identifier (ADR 0012 D1, ADR 0028). Passwords are never shown in analytics or logs. Error copy is blameless: «بيانات الدخول غير صحيحة» / 'Those details do not match an account'. Locked state names the wait, not the cause. Reset success returns to sign-in with the identifier prefilled.

screens.purpose: Optional app lock: a pre-prompt sheet after the first sign-in and the unlock screen shown on launch to returning users. Biometrics unlock a stored session; they never replace first login.
interactions: Pre-prompt sheet: 'Unlock Ghazal with Face ID' (wording follows the platform: Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint) with Turn on and Not now
Unlock screen: monogram, name and a single 'Unlock' button; the system prompt opens automatically once
After a failed attempt the fallback is the WhatsApp code (CL-AUTH-01) or password; three failures never lock the account, only the shortcut
The same toggle lives in Settings (CL-PROF-05)
screens.contentNotes: Unlock screen shows monogram «ر», 'Reem Al-Dosari' and the quiet line 'Unlock to continue' / «الفتح للمتابعة». Never a security-theatre lock icon larger than the monogram. Face ID usage description is localised in Info.plist strings. Unavailable state (no biometrics enrolled) hides the pre-prompt entirely and shows a disabled Settings row with the reason.
